integrity: An exact analytic argument proves all dimensions. Standalone finite-field Gaussian-elimination checks corroborate small moduli, without substituting finite data for a proof.
scientific_limitations: Odd moduli only; prime-conductor and full representation methods are classical. No spectral gap, even-modulus, nongenerating-support or publication-priority claim. The 2002 date is visible on the author-hosted preprint; no later journal date is substituted.
title: Odd-modulus Heisenberg three-tap convolution: a conductor determinant and exact kernel law
